title: Do Not Envy the Wicked

questions.question: Be not envious of evil men, nor desire to be with whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:1 (ESV): "nor desire to be with them,"

questions.question: By wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:3 (ESV): "and by understanding it is established;"

questions.question: By knowledge the rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:4 (ESV): "filled with all precious and pleasant riches."

questions.question: A wise man is full of strength, and a man of knowledge enhances his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:5 (ESV): "and a man of knowledge enhances his might."

questions.question: If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:10 (ESV): "If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small."

questions.question: For by wise guidance you can wage your war, and in abundance of counselors there is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:6 (ESV): "and in abundance of counselors there is victory."

questions.question: Wisdom is too high for a fool; in the gate he does not open his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:7 (ESV): "in the gate he does not open his mouth."

questions.question: Rescue those who are being taken away to death; hold back those who are stumbling to the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:11 (ESV): "hold back those who are stumbling to the slaughter."

questions.question: My son, eat honey, for it is good, and the drippings of the honeycomb are sweet to your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:13 (ESV): "and the drippings of the honeycomb are sweet to your taste."

questions.question: Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, and let not your heart be glad when he does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:17 (ESV): "and let not your heart be glad when he stumbles,"

questions.question: Whoever plans to do evil will be called a what?
The devising of folly is sin, and the scoffer is an abomination to whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:9 (ESV): "and the scoffer is an abomination to mankind."

questions.question: For the righteous falls seven times and rises again, but the wicked stumble in times of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:16 (ESV): "but the wicked stumble in times of calamity."

questions.question: Fret not yourself because of evildoers, and be not envious of the wicked, for the evil man has no what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:19-20 (ESV): "for the evil man has no future;"

questions.question: I passed by the field of a sluggard, by the vineyard of a man lacking sense, and behold, it was all overgrown with what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:30-31 (ESV): "and behold, it was all overgrown with thorns;"

key_verse_text: For the righteous falls seven times and rises again, but the wicked stumble in times of calamity.
